keynums.label: Total Distribution to Shareholders (deck's stated total, dividend + buyback)

bull_bear.body:
- "Net Cash of more than Rs. 1,000 Crores at group level."
- Distribution to Shareholders (deck's own stated totals): "Distribution of ~ Rs. 900 crores as dividend", "Distribution of ~ Rs. 1,200 crores through buyback of shares" and "Distribution of ~ Rs. 2,100 crores in form of dividend and buyback"; footnote notes the buyback announced in March 2021 closed with effect from 16th August 2021.
- Footnote to the distribution chart: "Declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 10 per equity share including Special Dividend of Rs. 3 per equity share".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Undisputed LEADER": Dainik Jagran leads the IRS 2019 Q4 rankings with a total readership of 6.9 Crs and is ahead of the No.2 newspaper by a margin of 1.6 crores readers, a lead of 30% (Source: IRS 2019 Q4).
- Described as a "Multi Media Conglomerate - Width, Depth and Heritage": 8 Publications, 39 Radio Stations, 300+ Editions / Sub Editions, 10 Language Operations, 13 State Print Presence, 19 Digital Media Portals, 5 Business Verticals, 83+ mn readers (IRS 2019 Q4), "Trusted by millions for over 7 decades".
- Two #1 print dailies - Dainik Jagran (Hindi) and Inquilab (Urdu); also cited as the leading website in Indian Health Information.
- Radio: Radio City's market share was 19% in Q1FY27 (Source: Aircheck 15 Markets); 29% of new clients on the radio platform advertised on Radio City, and the share of top 25 radio spenders increased to 21.8% from 15.6%, which the deck calls demonstration of deeper strategic partnerships.
- Digital: Jagran New Media (JNM) was amongst the top 15 in India in the news/information category, with a reach of ~48 Million Total Unique Visitors (Source: Comscore MMX Multi-Platform: June'26).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Group structure] "Jagran Prakashan Limited holds 74.05% of Music Broadcast Limited (RadioCity)"; the group is presented across Print, Digital, Activation, OOH and Radio.
- [Awards - internal contradiction] The awards slide text says distinguished bodies "have bestowed 96 Awards during the quarter", while the accompanying table totals "JPL Total 25" (Dainik Jagran 16, Jagran New Media 7, Jagran IT Team 2). Both readings are reported as printed.
- [Branding] "INext renamed as Dainik Jagran iNext".
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Jagran Prakashan as a multi-media conglomerate anchored by India's largest-read daily Dainik Jagran, with radio (74.05%-owned Music Broadcast/Radio City), digital, outdoor and events as the growth verticals, and net cash of more than Rs. 1,000 Crores at group level.
